headline: Revenue +17% (+12% cc) as NA retail comps rose 16% and Asia 31%; adj. EPS $2.80; initial FY27 guide of 4-5% cc growth.
guidance_note: FY27 cc revenue growth ~4-5% (52-week basis; 53rd week adds ~1 pt) with ~40-60 bps cc operating margin expansion.
key_messages: North America revenue +8% to $763M; NA retail comps +16% (stores +14%, digital +21%); NA wholesale flat as lower-tier doors cut.
Asia +31% reported (+28% cc) to $564M, comps +25%, on exceptional Lunar New Year sales in China.
Europe +18% reported but +6% cc; Europe operating margin 28.7% (+380 bps).
Global DTC comps +17% on mid-teens AUR growth and strong full-price selling; FY26 revenue $8.1B, adj. EPS $16.59.

consumer.income_split: Bloomberg framed it as luxury shoppers globally buying at full price.
consumer.big_ticket: Full-price channels led a 16% North America retail comp.
consumer.pricing: AUR up mid-teens on full-price selling and fewer promotions.

macro_read: Premium US consumers spent strongly at full price in early 2026, a sign upper-income discretionary demand was robust despite tariffs.
notes: Growth is as reported; a constant-currency North America figure was not found. North America retail comps are in the key messages.
Revenue $2.0B as rounded by the company; sources cite $1.97-1.98B.
EPS consensus null: sources cite ~$2.48 and $2.54 (one outlier $4.16).
Stock jumped ~10-12% intraday on 2026-05-21; close not confirmed, so null.
Gross margin 69.7% reported; YoY bps change not confirmed (one summary: adjusted +40 bps).
The digital figure is the North America digital comp. NA comp detail partly from call summaries.
